subject: Onboarding evidence: screening & training checklist for Lloyd Healthcare
messages:
From: Alyssa Trent <alyssa.trent@lloydhealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@lloydhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Lloyd onboarding evidence request: new cohort background checks + training

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement at Lloyd needs a short packet to close our compliance checklist before we enable production traffic. Specifically they asked for: 
- Confirmation that all new hires assigned to the Lloyd account have completed security awareness training (roster + completion dates)
- Redacted background-check confirmations for the 3 contractors starting Jan 4 (names: J. Doe, M. Patel, S. Liu)
- The current onboarding/offboarding control playbook or a summary of separation timelines and deprovisioning steps

Can you share these as a single ZIP or point me to a secure Drive folder? We need it by Friday so the SSO onboarding can be scheduled.

Best,
Alyssa
Alyssa Trent

alyssa.trent@lloydhealth.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Lloyd onboarding evidence request: new cohort background checks + training

Hi Alyssa,

Thanks for the clear list. We're happy to provide the materials — attaching a redacted background confirmation for J. Doe and a training roster export. The onboarding playbook is the attached docx; it includes our separation checklist and IAM deprovision timeline.

Notes:
- Background checks: we provide vendor-confirmation letters with PII redacted. The attached PDF is redacted per our policy. If Lloyd security requires original vendor case IDs, we can request them from ClearView; that will add ~24-48 hours.
- Training roster: the CSV has completion timestamps and certificate IDs. If you want a signed attestation, Monica can produce that.

I copied Marissa for the SSO schedule coordination.

Attachments: training_roster_2026-12_redacted.csv (CSV), bg_report_jdoe_redacted.pdf (PDF), onboarding_control_playbook_v2.docx (DOCX)

Regards,
Grace O'Connor
